FIBIU-17.name: SROI_READINESS_MODEL_v1.0.0

canonical_model.dimension_score: 100 * applicable criteria satisfied / applicable criteria total
canonical_model.global: arithmetic mean of the ten dimension scores, scale 0-100
canonical_model.bands: 0-39 Initial Preparation / 40-69 Partial Preparation / 70-84 Advanced Preparation / 85-100 High Preparation
canonical_model.band_copy_authority: V-22 - the legacy copy 'Audit-ready candidate' is PROHIBITED; it suggests certification or audit guarantee.
canonical_model.criterion_equal_weight: Every criterion weighs equally within its dimension.
canonical_model.readiness_model_version: SROI_READINESS_MODEL 1.0.0 - ALREADY SEEDED in governed_model_registry by migration 0040 (FIBIU-01). B5 references it by value and MUST NOT re-seed, edit or version it.

FIBIU-17.governed_not_applicable: A governed not_applicable SATISFIES its criterion and stays in BOTH numerator and denominator. It is valid only when established through governed state, decision and rationale - never automatic, never set by Stella. It is derived from the governed decision already persisted on the underlying object, never from a readiness-local flag.
FIBIU-17.d8_4_vacuity: D8-4 ('every open Stella high finding has human disposition') resolves DETERMINISTICALLY by vacuity in three of four situations: Stella not executed => satisfied by vacuity; Stella executed with zero high findings => satisfied by vacuity; all high findings disposed => satisfied; at least one high finding undisposed => not satisfied. Resolution-by-vacuity is automatic and is NOT a governed not_applicable. NO criterion of the 46 may resolve by consulting whether Stella is enabled, available or was invoked - this is a construction invariant, verifiable by test (V-17).
FIBIU-17.invariants: Readiness NEVER gates approval. No numeric threshold. A high score never compensates a failed gate. NO human or Stella may inject points. Historicals never change retroactively. Each run snapshots the global score, the ten dimensional scores, the criterion detail and readiness_model_version.
FIBIU-17.manual_input_removal: Removal of the manual readiness input, which today is a free numeric field that Portfolio averages and Stella's context consumes.
FIBIU-17.exit_gate: 46 criteria, ten dimensions, bands, and snapshot; no path writes authoritative readiness from human input.

FIBIU-18.name: SROI_SENSITIVITY_MODEL_v1.0.0
FIBIU-18.supersede_not_extend: lib/pipeline/sroi-sensitivity.ts applies a uniform SCENARIO_DELTA_PP = 10 to all four filters, non-persisted - precisely what the canonical methodology V-23 forbids. It is SUPERSEDED, NOT EXTENDED.
FIBIU-18.candidate_register: Deterministic per-run register built from the inputs and assumptions ACTUALLY USED, mandatorily including: the five adjustments deadweight, attribution, displacement, drop_off, duration - NONE omissible for being 0 or stable; every structured assumption flagged materially methodological; every financial proxy value used to monetize where a reasonable alternative/range/uncertainty exists; and any other quantitative engine input whose uncertainty could materially affect net social value, investment, ratio or interpretation - which captures discount_rate_pct.
FIBIU-18.disposition: Each candidate receives a human disposition variation_required | no_additional_variation_required | pending. Both non-pending states carry rationale.
FIBIU-18.scenarios: Every variation_required candidate needs at least one governed scenario identifying modified inputs, base value, alternative value/range, reason, relevant sources/assumptions, the human who selected or accepted it, and sensitivity_model_version. Upper AND lower scenarios are NOT both required when only one direction is defensible. One-at-a-time and combined scenarios are both permitted; combined must state what combination it represents and why.
FIBIU-18.same_engine: Scenarios execute through the SAME deterministic engine with only the declared inputs substituted. Stella never computes scenario ratios. The base run remains the authoritative result and is NEVER overwritten.
FIBIU-18.completeness: complete requires zero pending and at least one valid persisted scenario per variation_required. A run destined for approval fails closed while incomplete, surfacing as SENSITIVITY_INCOMPLETE.
FIBIU-18.no_threshold: No universal percentage threshold determines material sensitivity - the system computes and displays deltas deterministically; the reviewer determines materiality and records rationale.
FIBIU-18.no_confidence_interval: Min/max across scenarios may be shown ONLY as a scenario envelope, NEVER as a statistical confidence interval.
FIBIU-18.no_backfill: Pre-model runs stay legacy_non_authoritative. NO retrospective scenario backfill.
FIBIU-18.sensitivity_model_version: SROI_SENSITIVITY_MODEL 1.0.0 - ALREADY SEEDED in governed_model_registry by migration 0040 (FIBIU-01). Reference by value only.
FIBIU-18.exit_gate: The uniform +/-10pp is superseded and the completeness gate is operative.

readiness_reader_contract.matrix_is_a_different_metric_proven_by_c: methodology_review_matrix.readiness_score is computed by computeReadinessScore in lib/pipeline/methodology-review.ts as round(100 * sum(severity_weight * status_credit) / sum(severity_weight)) over items whose status is not not_applicable, with SEVERITY_WEIGHT {low:1, medium:2, high:3} and STATUS_CREDIT {pass:1, warning:0.5, fail:0}. It is scoped per (project, pipeline_step) over six pre-calculation steps and returns null when nothing is assessable. FIBC-021 weighs every criterion EQUALLY within its dimension, every dimension at exactly 10%, is scoped per run over ten dimensions, and counts a governed not_applicable as SATISFIED in BOTH numerator and denominator. The not_applicable treatment is EXACTLY OPPOSITE. They are not the same concept and no FIBDB item governs the matrix column.
